title: KṬP Thawhtan Zan Inkhawm Programme
author: Branch Secretary
content:
A hmun: Kohhran Biak In
A hun: Zan dar 7:00 PM
Hruaitu: Lalhruaitluanga (Branch Leader)
Thusawitu: Upa Bialtu
Zai hruaitu: Kohhran Zaipawl

Branch member zawng zawngte thahnemngai taka inkhawm turin kan in sawm a ni e.

title: Biak In Tual Hnatlang Kohna
author: Branch Secretary
content:
Inrinni zing dar 7:00 AM-ah Biak In tual leh a chhehvel tihfai hnatlang neih tur a ni a, Group tinte (Sadrak, Mesak, Abednego) mahni hmanraw neih ang ang (buhfaithir, bawlhhlawh bawm, chem) kenga kim taka thawkchhuak turin kan inngen e.

• Hnatlang thawh zawhah refreshment tuihnai tak a awm ang.

title: Kohhran Zaipawl Hla Zir
author: Branch Secretary
content: Zirtawp zan dar 6:30 PM-ah Biak In-ah Zaipawl hla zir tur a ni e. Member zawng zawng kim taka kal tur a ni a, hun vawn dik i ngaihpawimawh ang u.
